verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents defining dashboards or alerts as code. NerdGraph is described only as able to 'configure some New Relic features', without naming dashboards or alerts. The Terraform documentation covers managing agent fleets via Agent Control, not dashboards or alert policies, and the CLI docs mention tags, workloads and deployment markers. These are adjacent capabilities that do not show repeatable dashboard/alert provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
